explanation: The merge kept only the button click and dropped the FormClosed path, so the reach is short: FormClosed (line 343-345) sets OK when an Apply was done, whichever way the dialog closes (the title-bar X, Alt+F4, or the Cancel button), and the form's CancelButton is the same button (Designer 220), so Escape closes it and takes the same path. State the rule once at that reach: closing the dialog by any route other than OK reports OK if an Apply was done in this opening, Cancel otherwise; OK always reports OK. Also the button is labelled 'Cancel' (Designer line 170), not 'Close': CloseButton is only its code name, so drop 'also labelled Close' and use the label a person sees.
